This app requires environment variables that have no value yet: AGENT_AUTO_APPROVED_SKILLS, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_MODEL_PREF, APIPIE_LLM_API_KEY, APIPIE_LLM_MODEL_PREF, and 76 more. Set them in the application's Configuration screen before deploying.
Deployz ignores the deployment files in this repository (cloud-deployments/digitalocean/terraform/main.tf). It builds the Dockerfile and provisions the infrastructure itself.
